title: NEXY autonomous round 10A — canonical session identity
scope: DOC-C §4.2 GET /api/session/me and successful verify identity binding

Proved first-login sessions could be created without userId.
Materialized/bound User identity transactionally on successful first-login verify.
Made session/me response exact to canonical fields.
Revoked and rejected legacy orphan sessions with null userId.
Added integration tests for first-login identity and orphan fail-closed behavior.

claims_proofs.claim: Canonical session identity is guaranteed for new successful logins.
